title: Semantic purposes and Intention Service integration
summary: Purpose profiles let callers ask for BODY, HEADING, TABLE, UI, UI_COMPACT, CODE, PRINT_BODY, WEB_BODY or ACCESSIBLE_UI without knowing font filenames. Font operations are exposed through the existing Intention Service rather than a private natural-language dispatcher.
invariants: Purpose is semantic policy, not a renderer-specific font filename.
Purpose profiles remain centrally registered and queryable.
Font intentions adapt the same FontManager service; they do not create a second font authority.
Recognised operations include find, list, register, package, web-package, subset and measure.
Intention recognition and effectful execution remain subject to the Intention Service policy boundary.

provenance.claim: Core objects, purpose profiles and FontIntentions adapter.
Registered semantic purposes and purpose-to-query/find behavior.
Intentions are an adapter over the same service and future renderers depend on FontManager.
